snippet.title: Dumpster Gang - Console Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Dumpster Gang scampers to consoles in March 2027! Releasing for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, XBOX Series X|S, and XBOX Game Pass.  

Play as mischievous raccoons and cause as much mayhem as possible in this new chaotic co-op sandbox game! 1 to 4 players can scavenge dumpsters, steal junk, raid snacks, commit tiny crimes, and try to avoid the clutches of the evil exterminator. Work together to haul loot, solve puzzles, and rescue captured teammates, and at the end of each raid, head back to your hideout to customize it with all the junk treasure you've collected along the way.  

Wishlist for XBOX! https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/dumpster-gang/9nt0wk0qg9p2 

Wishlist for PS5! https://store.playstation.com/concept/10021026

Dumpster Gang releases for consoles in March 2027, but is available on PC from December 3rd 2026 via Steam, XBOX on PC, and PC Game Pass! Try the free demo right now on Steam and XBOX on PC. 

Join the Discord! https://discord.com/invite/dumpstergang 

Follow us on X: https://x.com/DumpsterGangHQ 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/curvegames/ 
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@curvegames 

#dumpstergang #multiplayergames #trailer
